mainEntity.name: How much does pool automation system installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of pool automation system installation varies significantly based on the system's features, the complexity of your existing pool setup, and whether it's a new installation or an upgrade. Basic systems that control primary functions like pumps and heaters can range from a few thousand dollars, while more advanced systems integrating lighting, water features, and chemical management can be substantially more. A detailed estimate requires an on-site assessment of your specific needs and existing infrastructure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool automation installation costs vary based on system features and complexity, typically ranging from a few thousand dollars for basic systems to higher for advanced integrations.
